seed.timestamp_command: date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'  (Git Bash on the PC; the PC's clock is Brisbane, UTC+10)
seed.derivation: seed = int(SHA-256(timestamp as ASCII bytes), 16); check: printf '%s' '<timestamp>' | sha256sum
